name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea
source:
At the turn of the century, Victorian life carries on with one sharp difference from our world- vampires run amok and are a part of every day life. After having run away from home to search for his best friend, the young Cecil meets Nemo, a pickpocketing vagabond. The two set out together but in order to find what they're searching for, they must first unravel the truth behind a series of brutal vampire attacks from a decade prior.

Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea is a Victorian-esque character drama visual novel revolving around 4 characters who become entangled in solving an unsolved massacre by a vampire.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804970/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世纪之交，维多利亚时代的生活仍在继续，只是与我们的世界有一个显著不同，吸血鬼四处出没，早已成了日常的一部分。年轻的塞西尔离家寻找挚友，途中遇见了以扒窃为生的流浪者尼莫。两人结伴上路，但想找到各自追寻的东西，首先必须揭开十年前一连串吸血鬼残暴袭击背后的真相。

《Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea》是一部具有维多利亚时代风格、侧重人物刻画的视觉小说，围绕四名被卷入吸血鬼屠杀悬案调查的人物展开。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804970/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea/]Steam[/url]]
